entries.name: UniverseStatusParser
entries.comment: Parses SERVER_APP payload into universe list entry; lw a1,0x18(a3) must=0 or handler skips; calls UniverseListAdd then MasConnectionInit if payload[0x2B4]!=0

entries.name: UniverseSearch
entries.comment: Search list by displayName; lb entry+0x338: if zero passes immediately (beqz); else strcmp("r0004",entry+0x338)

entries.name: UniverseListAdd
entries.comment: Add entry to universe list; stride=0x3D8; sw v1,0x4(s5) increments gUniverseCount; checks capacity (max 16)

entries.name: ServerRegistryLookup
entries.comment: Lookup server registry by hostname key (a0) into table (a1); returns ptr or 0; populates entry+0x338 (version) and entry+0x358 (patch URL) if found

entries.name: UniverseConnectDispatch
entries.comment: Calls UniverseSearch; if count=0 or not found falls back to ServerListConnect with a1=str_SERVER_LIST

entries.name: ServerListConnect
entries.comment: Connect using named entry from 256-entry server registry at 0x00725EF0; a1=key string e.g. "SERVER_LIST"

entries.name: CheckStatusCode
entries.comment: Returns v0=(a1==0); gates UniverseStatusParser; any non-zero status code skips entire parse

entries.name: MasConnectionInit
entries.comment: Init MAS TCP connection struct; called from UniverseStatusParser when payload[0x2B4]!=0; uses MAS hostname from entry+0x09C

entries.name: MasConnectionConnect
entries.comment: Start MAS TCP connect; calls 0x002EC880; a1=0 or hostname string

entries.name: StringCopyN
entries.comment: strncpy: a0=dst, a1=src, a2=maxLen

entries.name: StringCompare
entries.comment: strcmp; used in UniverseSearch for display name and version string match

entries.name: gUniverseListMgmt
entries.comment: Universe list management struct: [+0x00]=capacity(0x10), [+0x04]=count, [+0x08]=base ptr to entries

entries.name: gUniverseCount
entries.comment: Current populated entry count; 0 causes SERVER_LIST fallback in UniverseConnectDispatch

entries.name: gUniverseBase
entries.comment: Ptr to first universe entry; entry stride=0x3D8; max 16 entries; currently points to 0x00770650

entries.name: gUniverseConnectFlag
entries.comment: Set to 1 after SERVER_LIST fallback path taken (0x0031B200) or status parse skipped (0x0031B218)

entries.name: str_r0004
entries.comment: Patch version string; compared in UniverseSearch against entry+0x338; empty entry+0x338 also passes

entries.name: str_SERVER_LIST
entries.comment: Key used to look up fallback MAS server entry when universe list is empty

entries.name: displayName
entries.comment: Universe display name (128 bytes); compared in UniverseSearch via strcmp

entries.name: masHostname
entries.comment: MAS hostname/IP (128 bytes); PS2 connects to MAS at this address

entries.name: masPort
entries.comment: MAS port (int32 LE)

entries.name: description
entries.comment: Universe description / news string (256 bytes)

entries.name: statusDot
entries.comment: Status dot (1=green)

entries.name: userCount
entries.comment: Current user count displayed on server select

entries.name: maxUsers
entries.comment: Max users (0x2710=10000)

entries.name: masEnableFlag
entries.comment: MAS enable flag (non-zero = initiate MAS TCP connection after entry added)

entries.name: versionPatchStr
entries.comment: Version/patch string from payload (128 bytes); e.g. "r0004 http://patch..."; used by ServerRegistryLookup to populate versionStr

entries.name: versionStr
entries.comment: Version string set by ServerRegistryLookup; if empty (zero byte) UniverseSearch passes automatically

entries.name: patchUrl
entries.comment: Patch download URL set by ServerRegistryLookup (128 bytes); e.g. "http://patch.psrewired.com/s2/r0004/"

entries.name: gServerRegistryContext
entries.comment: Global pointer to server registry context; ServerRegistryLookup loads [0x001CC750] then uses +0x005c.

entries.name: gServerRegistryContext
entries.comment: Global pointer to server registry context; ServerRegistryLookup loads [0x001CC750] then uses +0x005c.

entries.name: registryListHead
entries.comment: Pointer field at registry context +0x005c used by ServerRegistryLookup; observed null in current run.

entries.name: registryListHead
entries.comment: Pointer field at registry context +0x005c used by ServerRegistryLookup; observed null in current run.

entries.name: UniverseStatusAddContinue
entries.comment: Continuation after second ServerRegistryLookup null branch; control continues here into UniverseListAdd setup.

entries.name: UniverseStatusAddContinue
entries.comment: Continuation after second ServerRegistryLookup null branch; control continues here into UniverseListAdd setup.

entries.name: UniverseStatusDispatchWrapper
entries.comment: LobbyExt msg 0x04 wrapper; checks masEnableFlag, sets status bit, then dispatches via function pointer at 0x0040C9A0.

entries.name: UniverseStatusDispatchWrapper
entries.comment: LobbyExt msg 0x04 wrapper; checks masEnableFlag, sets status bit, then dispatches via function pointer at 0x0040C9A0.

entries.name: pUniverseStatusParser
entries.comment: Dispatch table slot containing the UniverseStatusParser function pointer.

entries.name: pUniverseStatusParser
entries.comment: Dispatch table slot containing the UniverseStatusParser function pointer.

entries.name: str_MP_MEDIUS_ERROR
entries.comment: Embedded string within the data block used by the second ServerRegistryLookup call context.

entries.name: str_MP_MEDIUS_ERROR
entries.comment: Embedded string within the data block used by the second ServerRegistryLookup call context.

entries.name: UniverseStatusStatusFailExit
entries.comment: Early parser exit path taken when CheckStatusCode returns zero; sets gUniverseConnectFlag=1 and returns.

entries.name: UniverseStatusStatusFailExit
entries.comment: Early parser exit path taken when CheckStatusCode returns zero; sets gUniverseConnectFlag=1 and returns.

entries.name: MpMediusErrorLookupData
entries.comment: Data block passed as the second ServerRegistryLookup key/context; begins with two 0x0920 words and contains MP_MEDIUS_ERROR at +0x10.
